import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng = random.Random(31337)
lines=[]
# 1 big image compile (28899 nodes)
lines.append(open('/app/tmp/maximg_req.json').read().strip())
# 4 more 2048-rule compiles (total FIB 8192)
for k in range(4):
    seen=set(); fib=[]
    while len(fib)<2048:
        net=rng.getrandbits(128)
        if net in seen: continue
        seen.add(net); fib.append((net,128,rng.randrange(65536)))
    lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/128','hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
                             'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':8}))
imgs=[None]
for k in range(4):
    imgs.append(json.loads(json.dumps({'placeholder':1})))
# build lookups: reuse the big image 4 times with 20000 addrs each? total addr <= 50000
img=json.loads(open('/app/tmp/maximg.json').read())
tot=0
for k in range(3):
    n = 16000 if k < 2 else 18000
    addrs=[ref.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(n)]
    tot += n
    lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs}))
print('total addrs', tot, 'lines', len(lines), 'bytes %.1fMB' % (sum(len(x)+1 for x in lines)/1e6))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input='\n'.join(lines)+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=400)
print('agg: %.2fs rc=%d out %.1fMB' % (time.time()-t0, p.returncode, len(p.stdout)/1e6))
outs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
assert len(outs)==len(lines)
for o in outs:
    assert o.get('status') in ('ok','infeasible'), o
print('AGG OK')
PYEOF
